APPLICATION
· Adopt modular design to effectively reduce the failure rate of the whole machine.
· Well-knit design makes the robot more convenient in small space.
· The arm span is 712/916mm. It has strong payload capacity, and rated payload 7 Kg/6 kg. 
It is easily applied in multi application.
· Lighter structure design than other same level product, so it is easy to install inside a 
system or to mount upside -down
· High rigidity arm and top level servo control technology guarantee the smoothness and 
stability while the movement.
· Built-in cable and external cable fixing base to meet customization requirements.
· Adopt leak-proof structure
· High expansibility, multiple user bracket installation platforms are set on the robot 
body, which is convenient for users to fix cables and related auxiliary tools.

Safety Attentions
Please read carefully and understand totally of these instructions and other related documents BEFORE 
using this system. Please start using the system ONLY AFTER mastering all equipment knowledge, 
safety knowledge, and notices.
Safety attentions in this instruction are graded into four categories- DANGER, CAUTION, MUST, and 
FORBID
 indicating that death or severe injury will result if wrong operation is taken.
 indicating that medium or slight injury or equipment breakdown will result if 
wrong operation is taken.
 instructions that must be obey.
operations that mustn’t be taken.
It should be noticed that things labeled with CAUTION may also result into severe consequnces in 
different situation. So it’s very important to pay attention to every CAUTION instructions, and stay 
strictly with them.
Some instructions even may not be labeled with DANGER or CAUTION, but users should also obey 
them.

★Before operating the robot, press the “emergency stop” button on the teach 
box and make sure main power supply of servo is off and motor is in “off-power and 
brake” status. After cutting off the servo power, servo power button on the teach box 
is red.
Under an emergency, personal injury or equipment damage may result if robot cannot be stopped 
in time.
★When emergency is removed and servo power need connecting, please remove 
and deal properly with the incidence which causes the emergency, and then connect 
the servo power.
Personal injury may result due to the unwanted robot movement from wrong operation.
★When teaching within the robot movement region, please obey the following 
principle: keep observe the robot from the front
follow the operation manual strictly
consider the backup plan if robot move suddenly toward yourself
set up the shelter just in case
Personal injury may result due to the unwanted robot movement from wrong operation.
★When following processes are operated, make sure nobody is in the robot 
movement region and operator is in the safe position: powering the robot control electric 
tank
controlling the robot using teaching programmer
test running of robot
reoccurrence automatically
Personal injury may result when entering the robot movement region or contacting the robot. 
Press the emergency stop button immediately when exception occurs.

Safe operation protocols
★All the operators of robot systems should participate in system training, study safety protection 
measurements and understand robot functionality.
★Make sure no abnormal or dangerous situation of robot and auxiliary equipment occurs, before 
starting operating robot.
★ Unplug the power or press emergency stop button before entering the operation region, even robots 
aren’t running.
★ When programming within the movement region of robot, corresponding guard should be set to 
make sure that robot can be stopped under emergency circumstances. Please don’t wear gloves when 
teach and inch the robot. Please take the slow mode when inching the robot, in case emergency occurs and 
robot can be stopped efficiently.
★Operators must be familiar with the emergency stop buttons on the robot controller and periphery 
controller, to the degree that these buttons can be pressed exactly under emergency.
★Never think that static status of robot means the finish of program. Static robot is likely to receive the 
input signal to get moving.

1 Invoke of program instruction 
1. Turn the mode security switch to teach mode.
2. Switch to the program list interface, create or open a program.
3.Click the < > button in the status control bar, or click the < > < > button 
in the functional button area to invoke the frequently used instructions. When using functional area 
buttons, repeat clicking the button will result into the different instructions under the menu. Click 
< > button to invoke the instructions used last time.

4. After the input of correct instruction parameters, click < > button to input the instruction; click 
the < > button to cancel the instructions input.
These two operations should be carried out while pressing the security switch.

2 Description of Program Commands
1．<> contains the selected or input content. [Blank] contains nothing, meaning don’t use.
3．Program instruction line should select or input the following types of content: instructions, 
judgement symbol, data, status, number.
Instructions: instructions need invoking, e.g. MOVJ, JUMP, GP, LI, etc.
Judgement symbol: Used to judge the condition relationship, e.g. ==, ＞, ＜,>=, <=.
Assignment: Set the certain port into the certain condition, e.g. Y0=ON, M24=OFF.
Data: Data can be divided into digital, integer, minus, and characters according to the different 
instructions.
Status: (ON=1, OFF=0). The status can be used as the number 0, 1.
Number: Number should be integer larger than 0 (0 included) according to the different instructions. 
The number range may also different.
4．The additions may differ attached to the different instructions. Please pay attention to the additions.
5 ． Positions with downwards arrow symbol should be inputted by <up/down 
arrows>selecting rather than directly input. Otherwise errors may occur.
6．Please select the instructions according to the reality where many instructions are available in 
additional instructions position.
7．【Shortcut: 8 5 1】Invoke the instructions using shortcut. After showing the program instruction 
list, instructions can be invoked by using number button, arrow button, and enter button. Examples are 
as following:
【Shortcut: 8 5 1】Press 8,5,1to invoke SWITCH
【Shortcut: 2 1 E】Press 2,1, enter button to invoke RET
【Shortcut: 8 ↑ ↑ E】Press8, upward arrow, upward arrow, enter button to invoke FORBIDAXISEND.

Addition description 2: DOUT example: 
This addition is used to set a distance where the program should switch certain signal (M、Y)effective 
or ineffective, and to set a distance where restore that signal.
Example: MOVL VL=500MM/S PL=0 DOUT Y#(0)==ON START 10.0 END 10.0 Description: After 
executing this program, 10MM later, Y0 port change into open (ON). Robot keep moving to the point 
10MM away from the end, and Y0 change to close (OFF). Then program come to the end.
This function can be used to open/close the gun in painting operation.
Addition description 3: AOUT example: 
This addition is used to output the preset analog index in the movement or at the end point.
1)V I analog output: 
VI analog index output can only be used among the welding instructions. If V1 is not among the 
welding instructions, when this line is executed, system will alart and prompt: no welding info, AOUT is 
not allowed to change the welding current and voltage during the movement.
V is correspondent to welding voltage, while I is correspondent to welding current. When this 
instruction is executed from the beginning to the end, analog voltage will change linearly from welding 
voltage to setting voltage.
Example: 
Welding current 200A~analog index 4.95V, welding voltage 20V~ analog index 4.95V；Welding 
current 400A~analog index 9.95V, welding voltage 40V~analog index 9.95V.
ARCSTART# (0)
MOVL VL=500MM/S PL=0 AOUT V=40.0 I=400.0A
ARCEND# (0)
Description: 
When 1stline is executed, A1 and A2 will output the arc start voltage. When 1st line is finished, A1 
and A2 analog index output is 4.95V (Welding current and voltage).When 2nd line is finished, A1 and A2 
analog index output change linearly from4.95Vto 9.95V. When 3rd line is executed, voltage become arc 
ending voltage.
This function can be used in the situation where welding current and voltage need changing.
A1 A2 analog output: 
When this instruction is between the welding instructions, it’s ineffective, and system will output 
according with the welding process settings.

Page: 20 of 72
When this instruction isn’t between the welding instructions, system will output the A1 and A2 analog
indet at the end of this instruction line. This is called point output for short.
A3 A4 analog output: 
No matter if this instruction is between the welding instructions or not, when system execute this 
instruction, robot will operate from the beginning to end, A3 and A4 analog inex will change linearly from 
starting point to the end point. This is called linear output for short.
Example: 
MOVJ VJ=30% PL=0 ；Point A A3=0 A4=0
MOVL VL=500MM/S PL=0 AOUT A3=10.0 A4=10.0 ；Point B
Description: Robot moves from point A to point B, and A3 and A4 analog index change linearly from 
0V to 10V.

Integrated example of circular program without gesture:
Description
In order to move smoothly, please set the PL of every point (including starting point and every point 
on the arc) as 9.
Whole circle consists of ABC arc and CDA arc. Terminal of robot is lacated at the starting point.
Program as follows:
MOVL VL=500MM/S PL=9 Move from starting point to point A, taking A as the first point on 
the arc.
MOVC VL=500MM/S PL=9 POINT=2 Move from A to B, taking B as the second point on the arc.
MOVC VL=500MM/S PL=9 POINT=3 Move from B to C, takin C as the third point on the arc and as the 
first point on the arc CDA.
MOVC VL=500MM/S PL=9 POINT=2 Move from C to D, taking D as the second point on the arc.
MOVC VL=500MM/S PL=9 POINT=3 Move from D to A, taking A as the third point on the arc.
Whole circle with gesture consists of three arcs.
6 points is needed (2 3 4 5 6 7) as follows:
MOVL VL=500MM/S PL=9 Move from starting point to point 2, taking 2 as the first point on the 
arc.
MOVC VL=500MM/S PL=9 POINT=2 Move from point 2 to 3, taking 3 as the second point on the arc.
MOVC VL=500MM/S PL=9 POINT=3 Move from point 3 to 4, taking 4 as the third point on the arc and as 
the first point on the next arc.

first point on the next arc.
MOVC VL=500MM/S PL=9 POINT=2 Move from 6 to 7, taking 7 as the second point on the arc.
MOVC VL=500MM/S PL=9 POINT=3 Move from7 to 2, taking 2 as the third point on the arc. At this time,

1. Installation of electric control cabinet:
When installing the control cabinet, keep away from the heat source 
and the wall to make the air smooth without affecting the heat dissipation. 
It shall be installed outside the safety fence without affecting the opening 
and closing of the cabinet door. The robot body can be clearly seen at the 
installation position of the cabinet door, but it should not be too far away 
from the robot body.
2. Robot body installation：
Due to the large weight and fast movement speed of the robot 
body, the installation position of the robot needs to bear a large load. 
. A concrete foundation of more than 200mm is required for ground 
installation. If the foundation thickness is less than 200mm, steel plates 
shall be added and fixed with anchor bolts. When the foundation is 
uneven, the four corners shall be padded with gaskets with a thickness 
of more than 100mm. The installation shall not be too far away from the 
control cabinet.

3.3 Cable connection
CRP robot comes with its own connecting cable when it leaves the 
factory. Read relevant manuals carefully and connect wires as required.
In order to prevent electric shock accidents, the robot body, electric 
control cabinet and peripheral electrical equipment shall be reliably 
grounded separately before power on.
Ensure the wiring safety of the power line with high voltage, the 
equipment wiring shall be neat and orderly, the cable and wire routing 
shall be in the wire groove, and the cable length shall be reasonably 
selected according to the diff erent functions of the equipment and cables.
The robot control cabinet of CRP is equipped with safety board. 
Please refer to the instructions of relevant robot electric cabinet for safe 
wiring.
It is forbidden to plug and unplug the connector with power.

▶ During auto-running, if the robot is found to be working 
abnormally, the emergency stop button should be pressed quickly.
▶ After emergency stop, the current working status of the robot may 
be abnormal. When resetting the robot to alarm, special attention should 
be paid.
When the robot is in Play mode, and the program is running. After 
stopping the program with the emergency stop button, to start the robot 
again, follow these steps:
1. First, check whether the robot body, fixture, etc. are abnormal? Can 
you continue running the program?
2. Then rotate to release the emergency stop button; Press the 【 R 】 
key to reset the current alarm information.
3. Click 【Serve down】switch to【Server on】.
4. Reduce the speed of play mode and switch the running mode to run 
in a single line run mode.

5. Repeatedly press the< ◎ >key to test if the program is working 
abnormally.
6. After confirming that the robot is working normally, increase the 
speed and switch the working mode to Infinite loop mode or single loop 
mode.
7. Click on the program key and the robot starts working.

1.Introduction to RH robot
CRP-RH series robots are hollow series robots developed by Chengdu 
CROBOTP Robot Technology Co., Ltd. It can be used in welding, handling, 
cutting, spraying, grinding and other related fi elds. CRP-G4-CD60 specifi cation 
drive control integrated electrical control cabinet is adopted.
The main features of this series of robots are as follows:
• it is equipped with a safety emergency stop board independent of the 
control system. Imported forced disconnect relay is used to provide double 
circuit emergency stop externally to ensure the reliability of emergency stop.
• The function of automatic external power on : it can ensure the personal 
safety of the operator when the operator's line of sight shifts away from the 
robot.
• Energy saving mode: eff ectively reduce standby energy consumption. At 
the same time, avoid injury caused by personnel entering the robot area by 
mistake in the standby state.
• built in three-phase transformer, 380V and 200V isolation, more stable 
power supply. Built in three-phase fi lter can eff ectively isolate external 
interference and prevent internal interference output.
• Dual switching power supply design to avoid internal power interference. 
• Special cables for high fl exible robots are used for the body cables. Avoid 
failure caused by internal circuit damage.
• The body is provided with double circuit gas pipes to meet the connection 
requirements of welding and handling.

• 6-axis hollow large inner diameter, which can meet the installation 
requirements of water-cooled gun and bellows gun. At the same time, avoid the 
entanglement of handling fixture pipeline and cable.
• Welding cable can be built in to facilitate the use of welding robot.
2. Description of G4 control cabinet (electric cabinet)
2.1 Introduction to control cabinet
CRP-G4-CD60 control cabinet has the following characteristics:
• Adopt split design; It is divided into power supply room and control room. 
The power supply room mainly focuses on heating devices, and adopts a multi 
group fan + air duct design to ensure good heat dissipation of heating devices. 
The control room is isolated from the power supply room to prevent dust and 
oil from entering the control room, ensure the cleanliness of the control room, 
and avoid abnormal operation of components in the control room affected by 
dust and oil.
• Multiple sets of anti-interference components: power filter, isolation 
transformer, dual switching power supply. Ensure the stable and reliable 
operation of the control cabinet.
• The built-in safety emergency stop board adopts double safety relays.

When any emergency stop is pressed, the strong current circuit and the servo 
unit deal with the emergency at the same time and forcibly stop the robot. 
Thereby achieving a safe emergency stop.
• collision softening: when the anti-collision signal is effective, the system 
and the drive respond at the same time to quickly soften the attitude axis and 
avoid damaging the body and welding gun.

3.2.11 Braking resistance (R1)
Braking resistance is also called regenerative resistance. It is used when 
the servo motor starts to consume excess energy when the generated energy 
exceeds the energy charged by the capacitor in the generator mode.
The generator mode includes the following conditions:
1. During deceleration stop during acceleration and deceleration operation.
2. The servo motor formed by the load side operates continuously without 
interruption (load).
Specification and model: 800W 20RJ
★Note
1. Since the braking resistor is mainly used for energy consumption, it will generate 
a lot of heat according to the movement of the robot, so it is strictly prohibited to touch 
it when it is powered on.
2. Good heat dissipation conditions shall be guaranteed due to heat generation.
3. After the main switch is turned off, wait for more than 5 minutes before touching 
the surface of the brake resistor.

3.2.12 Air duct / fan
During the operation of the integrated drive control unit, its power devices 
will generate a large amount of heat, which is mainly conducted to the radiator 
of the integrated drive control unit. If the heat cannot be effectively dissipated, 
the integrated drive control unit will give an over temperature alarm. And the air 
duct and the air duct fan are specially used to dissipate this part of heat.
At the same time, the air duct fan is also used to dissipate the heat of the 
braking resistor.
Specification and model: ME80252V1-000C-A99
★Note
Air ducts and fans need regular inspection and maintenance to prevent blockage, 
failure and influence on heat dissipation effect.
3.2.13 UK1/UK2/UK3
The band brake power supply UK2 / UK3 is mainly used to supply power to 
the robot body and external axis servo motors. IO power supply UK1 is mainly 
used to supply power to I / O board. Double switching power supply design is 
used to avoid interference to IO signal and control system when holding brake 
operates.
Specification and model: UK1: LRS-50-24 UK2: LRS-100-24 UK3: LRS-100-24

3.2.14 Filter (RC1)
It is mainly used to power the drive control integrated unit.
The selection of transformer capacity is directly related to the load. The 
control cabinet adopts a three-phase isolation transformer to avoid the danger 
of electric shock caused by any line at the output end contacting with people 
and ensure the safety of electricity; At the same time, the input end and the 
output end are completely isolated, which can filter the input power supply well 
and prevent interference.
The control cabinet is currently configured with the following specifications:
SG5000VA: for RH14-10 with external shaft.
SG8000VA: for RH14-10 with external shaft.
★Note
1. When the transformer is working, the input terminal still carries strong current, so 
it is forbidden to touch it when it is energized to prevent electric shock.
2. Heat will be generated during the operation of the transformer, so it is strictly 
prohibited to touch it when it is powered on to prevent scalding. At the same time, good 
ventilation conditions shall be ensured.
3.2.15 Main fan of electric cabinet
There are transformers, radiators of integrated drive control units, braking 
resistors and other heating devices in the power supply room; If the robot can 
not get good heat dissipation, it will lead to a series of abnormalities such as 
abnormal operation of the robot and alarm. The main fan of the electrical 
cabinet is used for ventilation and heat dissipation of the power supply room. In 
order to ensure a good heat dissipation effect, it is necessary to regularly check 
the operation of the fan and the blockage of the air outlet.

5.1 MC circuit description
MC circuit of our company mainly refers to on-off of main contactor. It is 
mainly used to cut off and connect the power supply of the main contactor 
control servo. This circuit is mainly realized by the safety emergency board. 
When the emergency stop button is pressed or the drive gives a serious alarm, 
the MC circuit is disconnected, the motor is locked, the drive power supply is 
cut off , and the robot enters a safe state.

5.2 Energy saving mode
5.2.1 Introduction
Energy saving mode means that when the robot is in the enabled state, the 
system is not in the wait state, and the system does not send pulses to control 
the motor to run, if it exceeds 1 minute, the system will automatically disenable 
it, and the motor will brake.
Main uses:
Safe :When the conditions for the energy-saving mode are met, the robot 
is quiet and still. and the operator enters the working area because they think 
that the robot has stopped; However, at this time, the robot is still enabled. 
Once the motion is triggered, the robot will start to operate immediately, which 
will cause injury to personnel or equipment. The timeout is automatically 
disenabled, which can well avoid this risk. 
 Energy saving: when the servo is enabled, the motor brake need energy to 
drive. After the disenable, the brake is locked (restored to the original position, 
the robot joint is locked), and the motor is in a free state, no longer consuming 
energy.
5.2.2 Energy saving mode adjustment
When the customer uses external equipment (PLC, etc.) to control the start 
and stop of the robot on site, there may be timeout, too short time, or conflict 
with the energy saving mode. Please contact our technical personnel at this 
time.
WARNING
Based on the safe use of the energy-saving mode, do not adjust the energy-saving 
mode unless it is absolutely necessary.

5.4 Description of expansion axis (CDK □)
5.4.1 Introduction
Present, the CRP-G4-CD60 electric cabinet can be expanded by two axes. 
The maximum rated current of the expanded axis module is 15A. When the 
motor exceeds 15A, it cannot reach the rated load. 
When adding the expansion axis, you also need to adjust:
1. Adjust the brake power supply (UK2) from 100W to 150W, otherwise the 
brake cannot be opened eff ectively. For the leaving factory electric cabinet with 
expansion shaft, the band brake power supply has been adjusted to 150W.
2. Transformer (TC1) is adjusted from 5000VA to 8000VA. For the leaving 
factory electric cabinet with expansion shaft, the transformer has been adjusted 
to 8000VA.

1. Turn off the main power supply (SQ1) of the control cabinet and turn off 
the front-end power switch input to the control cabinet.

4. Install the expansion axis (CDK1 or CDK2) to the reserved position 
of the electrical cabinet, and connect the interconnection cable (X03-X04, 
X05-X06, X07-X08) with CD60-CRX8. Please refer to the following figure (see the 
attachment for the wiring diagram of expansion 9 and 10 shafts).
Fig.5.4.1
5. Connect the expansion axis motor. The motor encoder line is connected 
to the X72 terminal of CD60-CRX8. The power line of the expansion axis motor is 
connected to the X70 (7-axis) and X80 (8-axis, if any) terminals of CDK □.

①Sequential execution: the execution of PLC is to execute step by step the program file of the command list line by line,

②Cyclic execution: PLC executes from the beginning of the ladder diagram (command list) to the end of the ladder

3. Basic logic commands in command list
In the CD60-CRX8 system, there are 16 basic logic commands in the PLC command list, which are used to 
achieve basic logic control.
3.1 LD, LDI, OUT command
LD：Normally open contact and bus connection command.
LDI: Normally closed contact and bus connection command .
OUT：Relay coil output command.
LD and LDI commands can be used for X, Y, M, T and C. They can also be used with AND and ORB commands for the 
starting point of a branch circuit. OUT command can be used for Y, M, T and C, but cannot be used for input relay X.
3.2 AND and ANI command
AND：Normally open contact series connection command.
ANI：Normally closed contact series connection command.
AND and ANI commands can be used for X, Y, M, T, and C.
3.3 OR and ORI command
OR：Normally open contact parallel connection command.
ORI: Normally closed contact parallel connection command.
OR and ORI commands can be used for X, Y, M, T and C.
3.4 ORB command
ORB: Parallel connection command for series circuit blocks. 
A circuit formed by connecting two or more contacts in series is called a "series circuit block". When connecting a series 
circuit block in parallel, use the ORB command.
3.5 ANB command
ANB：Series connection command for parallel circuit blocks.
The ANB command connects the parallel circuit block in series with the previous circuit. Before using the ANB 
command, the internal connection of the parallel circuit block should be completed.
3.6 MPS, MRD, MPP stack memory and multiple output command
The MPS, MRD, and MPP commands are the in-stack, read-stack, and out-stack commands, respectively, and are 
used for multiple output circuits.
3.7 SET and RST command
Set command: an command to hold an operation.

5 / 42
Reset command: an command to keep the operation reset.
SET command can be used for Y and M, RST command can be used for Y, M, T and C.
3.8 NOP and END command
NOP: null operation command.
END: end command, which means the end of the program.

4.2.3 Internal relay (M)
The internal relay is an auxiliary relay in the PLC and cannot be directly output to an external source. It is usually 
defined as the input, output or status of a certain function, and is the channel for information transmission between the 
PLC and the core control software of the system. He has the following characteristics:
（a）These relays are cleared when the power is turned off.
（b）Normally open contacts and normally closed contacts of internal relays that can be used in ladder diagrams
（c）The internal relay number is expressed in decimal numbers. Most internal relays have been defined by the system 
for a certain function and control mode, and only some internal relays are used as temporary intermediate signals.
4.2.4 Timer (T)
The timer in the system PLC is equivalent to the time relay in the relay system. In this system, the timer is divided 
into general timer and totalizer timer. The constant K is used as the set value of the timer.
General timer
Its working principle is: when the input condition is met, start counting, when the timing reaches the set value, the 
timer contact is turned on; if the input condition is turned off, the timer count value will be set to 0, and the contact will 
also be turned off open. The timer setting value (K) is a decimal number, which can be in the range of 1 to 9999.
Example: As shown in Figure 5.3, when the input relay X5 is valid, the timer T01 counts when it is on. After 0.5 
seconds (K value is 50, T01 is a 10ms timer), the T01 contact turns on. When the input relay X5 is invalid, the timer T01 
If it is set to 0, the contact is also open.

Totalizer timer
Its working principle is: when the input condition is met, start counting, when the timing reaches the set value, the 
timer contact is turned on; even if the input condition is turned off, the current value (counting value) of the accumulative 
timer will remain and the contact state Does not change. When the RST command is executed, the count value of the 
accumulative timer will be set to 0, and the contact will be disconnected. The timer setting value (K) is a decimal 
number, which can be in the range of 1 to 9999.
Example: As shown in Figure 5.4, when the input relay X5 is valid, the timer T04 counts when it is on. After 1 
second (K value is 100, T04 is a 10ms timer), the T04 contact is on, as shown in the waveform diagram, even if the 
input condition X5 is off On, the current value (counting value) of the accumulative timer T04 will still be maintained, and 
the contact status will not change. When the input relay X7 is valid, the timer T04 is reset to 0, the contact is also 
disconnected, and when the input signal is valid again, T04 starts counting again.
4.2.5 Counter (C)
The counter is used to accumulate and detect the rising edge of the input condition (X, Y, M, T). Therefore, when 
the input condition is ON, the count does not change. The response cycle is 100ms. Therefore, the on and off duration 
of the input condition should be greater than 100ms. The PLC of this system has 16 counters C01-C15, which have the 
following characteristics:
(a) The count value is a decimal number and can be specified in the range of 1 to 9999. 
(b) Even if the count value of the counter is not cleared when the input condition is closed, the count value of the counter 
must be cleared by the RST command 
(c) The normally open contacts and normally closed contacts of the counter can be used in the ladder diagram.
Example: As shown in the figure below, after the X5 input impedance signal is valid, C0 is reset, its corresponding 
count value is set to "0", and its normally open contact is disconnected (the normally closed contact is connected). The 
X7 input signal is used to provide the counting input signal. When the reset input of the counter is disconnected and the 
counting input signal changes from disconnected to connected (that is, the rising edge of the counting pulse), the 
current value of the counter is increased by 1. After 9 input count pulses, the C0 counter is valid (constant K is 9), its 
normally open contact is on (the normally closed contact is off), and the Y0 output is valid. If the pulse counter count 
value remains unchanged until the reset input signal is valid, the count value of the counter is set to "0".

6. Editing of PLC program
PLC trapezoidal editing of the CD60-CRX8 control system can be transmitted to the system for running 
through using the special PLC editing software (PLC.EXE) to edit and produce PLC files plc.lad (ladder diagram file) 
and plc.plc (command list file), or directly edit the ladder diagram to run on the system.
6.1 PLC ladder diagram examples
A. Example of reading rising edge
Work description: Use PLC to execute sequentially within a scan cycle to read rising or falling edges. X00 is 
the input port that needs to be read, and M200 and M201 are auxiliary relays. The rising edge of the read is stored 
in M202. When it needs to be read again, M202 needs to be reset (program or PLC reset). 
When the first line is executed in sequence, if X00 changes from invalid to valid, M200 is valid. 
In the second line, as the previous M200 is already valid, the normally open M200 in the second line is turned 
on, and the normally closed M201 has not been executed yet, and the normally closed M201 is in the on state. At 
this time, the M202 is set to be valid.

40 / 42
When running to the third line, as the previous M200 is valid and the normally open M200 is valid, then M201 
is valid.
B． Example of reading falling edge
Work description: Use PLC to execute sequentially within a scan cycle to read rising or falling edges. X00 is 
the input port that needs to be read, and M200 and M201 are auxiliary relays. The rising edge of the reading is 
stored in M203. When it needs to be read again, M203 needs to be reset (program or PLC reset). 
When the first line is executed in sequence, if X00 changes from valid to invalid, M200 will change from valid 
to invalid.
In the second line, since the previous M200 is invalid, the normally closed M200 in the second line is 
connected. The previous cycle M201 has been valid, and the current period has not been executed yet, and the 
normally open M201 is in the connected state. At this time, set M203 in valid. 
When running to the third line, because M200 was invalid before, M201 is invalid.

Chapter 1.Basic Description
1.1 Basic Concepts of Coordinates
When performing axis operations on a robot, the following coordinate systems are 
available:
1.1.1 Joint Coordinate System
Each axis of the robot performs a separate action, called the joint coordinate system.
1.1.2 Rectangular Coordinate System
No matter where the robot is located, it can move parallel along the set X, Y and Z axes.
1.1.3 Tool Coordinate System
The tool coordinate system takes the effective direction of the tool held by the robot wrist 
flange as the Z axis and defines the coordinates at the tip point of the tool.
1.1.4 User Coordinate System
The robot moves in parallel along each axis of the specified user coordinate system.
In other coordinate systems other than the joint coordinate system, only the tool pose 
can be changed without changing the tool tip point (control point) position. This is called the 
control point invariant action.

2.1 The preparatory work
2.1.1 Establishment of user coordinate system
Establish a user coordinate system for easy programming during programming. As 
shown in the figure below, there are several tooling faces that require several user coordinate 
systems.
The user coordinate system setting steps are as follows:
User coordinates are set on the interface of 【Run prepare】 - 【User coordinate 】(as

As shown above, after selecting the user coordinate system number, click <Calibration>

In the interface shown above, first set the origin of the user (workpiece) coordinate 
system, that is, the robot tip end point (with the welding wire on the welding torch) to the 
end of a corner of the workpiece. Then press <Record Point> to record the origin of the user 
(workpiece) coordinates.

Select [XX ] to determine the X side, as shown below.
In the above interface, set the X direction of the user (workpiece) coordinate system, 
that is, the tip of the robot is not pointed to the edge of one side of the workpiece. Then press

In the above interface, set the Y direction of the user (workpiece) coordinate system, 
that is, the tip of the robot moves to the edge of the other side of the workpiece. Then press

After determining the origin, XX direction, and YY direction, press <Calculate> in 
the above figure, the system automatically completes the calculation of the current user

workpiece.
Note: The user coordinate system is established by referring to the right hand helix rule 
(as shown below), Z is in the direction of thumb which rotates from X to Y. When establishing 
workpiece coordinates, the positive direction of Z is usually far away from the workpiece. 
Therefore, it is necessary to consider which one of X and Y directions are respectively 
considered when establishing workpiece coordinates.
After calculating the user coordinate system, it can switch to the user coordinate system 
to verify whether it is the desired user coordinate direction.
After verification, press <Cancel >to exit.

2.1.3 Welding Machine Parameter Setting
This step involves related parameters of welding machine control.
The relevant parameters of the welding machine control are set at the interface of 【Arc

2.1.3.1 Basic parameters：
Restart distance: used to set the retraction distance of the arc starting again after the 
first arcing is not successful or the arc is broken.
Restart speed: used to set the speed of return at which the arc starts again after the first 
arc start is not successful or the arc is broken.
Arcstart err time: It is used to set how long the system will be delay to check after 
detecting the arc starting.
Arc detection Time: Used to set the duration of successful arcing signal detected by the 
system, that is, the system must continuously detect the duration of successful arcing signal 
to consider successful arcing.
Arc run out time: It is used to set the duration of the system to detect the extinction 
signal (the arc deactivation is cancelled). That is, the system must continuously detect the 
extinction signal for the duration of the parameter and consider the arc extinction to be 
successful.
Scratch distance：Used to set the forward moving distance of the arc again when the 
arc is unsuccessful.
Scratch speed：It is used to set the running speed when the arc restarting is 
unsuccessful and the arc restarting is successful and the arc breaking point is returned.
Gas preflow time: it is used to set how long to send protective gas in advance when the 
system prepares for arcing.
Gas postflow time: It is used to set how long the protection gas will be closed after the 
system is ready to extinguish the arc.
2.1.3.2 Functional options
Arc break detection: Used to set whether there is interruption detection function. 
When this function is effective, the system will stop the welding action and save the arc 
breaking point in the middle of welding, and the robot will return to the arc breaking point 
and run after the arc breaking point is restarted next time.
If it is necessary to revoke the arc breaking point, switch to teaching mode and reset the 
arc breaking point. Correspond to auxiliary relay M180.
Power failure: used to set whether there is a detection function of welding machine 
fault. When the function is valid, the system will stop the welding action if the welding 
machine fails in the middle of the welding process; if the function is invalid, the abnormal 
welding power supply will not be detected during the welding process.
Reserve: the system starts, check the option, and the function takes effect after the 
arcing instruction is run. The corresponding auxiliary relay M181.
Coolant shortage: Used to set whether there is water-cooling anomaly function. When 
this function is effective, the system will stop welding when abnormal water cooling occurs in 
the middle of welding.
The effective time is similar to that of welding machine. Corresponding to auxiliary relay 
M182.

Return to path: Used to set whether there is a restart function. When this function is 
effective, the system starts arcing again after starting or stopping arc, and operates according 
to the speed and retreat distance set by basic parameters.。 
Scratch start：Used to set whether there is an sratch function. When the function 
is effective and the arcing fails again, the system operates according to the speed and the 
backoff distance set by the basic parameters to start the arcing again.
Collide detect: Used to set whether there is anti-collision function. When the function 
is effective, the anti-collision sensor will stop the welding action and servo power down.
Reserve: After the system is powered on, it takes effect. The collision avoidance 
detection corresponds to the auxiliary relay M13.

9.Some skills and precautions in using digital welding machine:
9.1 Unification of Megmeet
The so-called unification of welding refers to the welding opportunity automatically 
matching the welding voltage according to the given welding current and the corrected value 
of unified voltage.
The unified setting of Megmeet welder should first open the function on the welder 
side, Just press the SYNERG./Separate key.Entering the unified mode, the matching voltage 
and arc length correction can be viewed by right-loop switch key.The right-cycle switch key 
is switched to the unified voltage correction value " ±".When the indicator light is on or 
flickering, the automatic matching voltage in the unified mode can be fine-tuned by adjusting 
the voltage knob on the wire feeder or the panel knob on the power supply of the welding 
machine, as shown in the figure.
The default value of voltage correction in the unification is 0, ranging from - 30% to + 
30%. The current welding voltage relationship is as follows:
Current welding voltage = unified voltage value + (voltage corrected value%) * (unified 
voltage value)
9.2 Some Parameter Settings of MEGMEET Welder and System
① Arcing time
Arc starting time can be set for both welding machine and system. It is necessary to set 
the same arcing time for both welding machine and system in order to perform arc starting 
correctly.
② Preparatory/delayed gas delivery time
The lag time of gas delivery is the same as the time of preparing gas delivery. The lag time 
of gas delivery is also set according to the time set at the welding machine side.
③ Arc starting time (P17 on welding machine)
This parameter should be consistent with the setting value of the welding machine before 
it can take effect normally.
④ Arc closing time (P18 on welding machine)
This parameter should be consistent with the setting value of the welding machine before 
it can take effect normally.
⑤ P02 Slow wire feeding speed

Slow wire feeding speed refers to wire feeding speed before starting arc. Slow wire 
feeding speed will affect the speed of starting arc. The greater the speed of slow wire feeding, 
the faster the arcing, and vice versa, but too large setting may cause deflagration blockage of 
conductive nozzles. The optimum value should be set according to the actual situation.
⑥ P01 reburning time
The reburning time refers to the time when the welding wire will continue to burn at 
the end of the welding to control the elongation of the rod. However, because the action of 
our system does not match the welding machine, the parameter will lead to excessive dry 
elongation after the completion of the procedure, so it is suggested that it should not be 
opened.
9.3 Some conditions affecting the arcing time are as follows:
① Arc Detection Confirmation Time
This parameter will be maintained in situ for a certain time after successful arcing, and 
will continue to move after confirming successful arcing, which will directly affect the speed 
of arcing time. Because of the detection of arc breaking, it is suggested that the user set this 
parameter to 0.
② Slow wire feeding speed
The description of this parameter is shown on the previous page.
③ Preparatory gas supply time
After setting this parameter, the arc will start after a period of gas supply before arcing, 
which will also affect the arc-starting tempo of welding.
④ Length of rod extension before welding
The arcing speed is largely affected by the length of the stem at that time. The closer the 
length of the welding front rod is to the workpiece, the faster the arcing is. This is consistent 
with the idea of speeding up the slow wire feeding speed. The length of the rod will make the 
arcing time very different.
9.4 Matters needing attention
In normal welding, please seclect function of arc breaking 
detection . In welding, the robot can make correct alarm and ARC-BREAKING action in the 
case of wire feeder failure, ground wire loosening, power cut-off, servo disconnection and so 
on. The following are dangerous actions which may cause safety accidents and losses. Please 
note that
Dangerous actions:
1 If the arc-break detection function is not selected, if there is such a situation that the 
ground wire is loose, the wire feeder will be in a state of continuous wire output without any 
alarm.
2 If the arc-breaking detection function is not selected, under normal welding, if the 
welder is powered off, the arc is extinguished, the wire is stuck to the base metal, and the 
robot is still moving, and the base metal may be pulled away from the original or Causes 
damage to the wire feeder.
3 Please try to reduce the speed of the test run when teaching the program, so as not to 
overshoot the wire or damage the workpiece.

Chapter 4.Welding related functions
4.1 Speed and Rate Adjustment in Welding Process
Welding process speed: In the welding instruction, the speed of movement instruction 
can be set between the beginning of welding and the end of welding. The speed can be 
set to linear speed mm/s and multiple speed. Speed control can facilitate debugging and 
commissioning process. It runs at the actual speed of the instructions during commissioning 
and at the speed set by the welding instructions during actual welding.
4.2 Manual wire feeding and withfeedback
In the display interface of the robot teaching box, there is a special wire feeding and wire 
withfeedback button, which can conveniently control the welding machine to feed and wire 
withfeedback under the manual state, and the speed of wire feeding and wire withfeedback 
depends on the setting speed of the welding machine. Convenient on-site adjustment of 
welding wire
4.3 Jog wire feeding and wire feedback
In the display interface of the robot teaching box, there is a special push button for wire 
feeding and withfeedback. Under the manual state, wire feeding and withfeedback can be 
carried out at a fixed time according to the set time of wire feeding and withfeedback. The 
quantity of wire feeding at each point can be controlled, and the speed of wire feeding is 
determined by the set speed of the welding machine. It is convenient to adjust welding wire 
on site.
4.4 Gas detection
Gas detection: There are special gas inspection keys on the interface of the robot teaching 
box, which can conveniently inspect the condition of protective gas.
4.5 Simulated welding
Simulated welding runs according to the actual welding trajectory, but does not start arc, 

wire feeding,gas feeding operation. The welding trajectory and speed are the same as the 
actual welding. Simulated welding has special keys on the interface of robot teaching box. It 
can be used to check welding procedure or repair welding.
4.6 Arc break point retention
In the process of arc-breaking, the robot will automatically record the position of ARCBREAKING point. After checking and eliminating the factors of arc-breaking, it will run the 
program again at the command line of arc-breaking. The robot will automatically run to the 
ARC-BREAKING point first, and then start the arc again. After program reset or welding reset, 
the saved arc breaking point will be cleared.
4.7 Welding monitoring
When the robot runs the welding procedure, the welding monitoring can be intuitively 
viewed: welding current, voltage, welding time, program running time, welding duty ratio 
and other parameters. It is convenient to analyze and optimize the program.
 
4.8 Welding parameter control:

Welding instructions support welding current and voltage regulation. It is convenient for 
customers to adjust welding parameters directly in welding procedure.
4.9 Collide detection (AF_SER)
On the special terminal board for robots, there is a set of special [Collide detection] signal 
interface, which cooperates with the Collide detection switch attached to the welding torch 
or other fixture. When the welding torch or fixture collides with the workpiece or tooling, the 
robot can be stopped in time to avoid the damage of the equipment to the greatest extent.
Detection switch
·Collide detection
After clicking the check box, open the Collide detection function

4.10 Wire feedback
When this function is enabled, the welding wire will automatically retract when the 
robot moves to the next weld (empty travel) after the completion of one weld, so as to avoid 
collision with workpiece or fixture and lead to the occurrence of wire bending, so as to realize 
the smooth arc initiation of subsequent welding.

Wire feedback setting
·Wire FB (ms)
The existing function only supports the unit of ms, and the setting value is the duration 
of the spinning action.
·Wire auto feedback
After the check box is clicked, the welding is completed and the spinning function is 
turned back.
4.11 Arc in advance
In general, when the robot reaches the starting point of welding, the robot stops and 
gives arcing instructions. The wire feeder slowly feeds the wire forward until the welding wire 
touches the base metal and successfully starts the arc. Flying arc initiation means that before 
the robot reaches the starting point of welding, it starts to execute arc initiation instructions 
and start slow wire feeding. When the robot reaches the starting point of welding, the 
welding wire and the base metal touch successfully to start arc. So the welding rhythm can be 
shortened.
Arcstart in advance setting
· Arc in advance time MS
Set the value of how long to start arc preparation before the start of welding. Arc is 

started directly when the welding position is reached.
· Arc in advance
After clicking the check box, turn on the Flight Arc function
4.12 Restart (lap welding)
When this function is enabled, arc breaking or welding suspension occurs during the 
welding process. When it needs to be re-welded, the robot will automatically retreat a certain 
distance along the welding forward direction, and overlap with the previous arc stopping 
points to avoid bad results. This function is suitable for girth welding or welding of products 
with sealing requirements.
Rerurn to path switch
·Rerurn to path switch
After clicking on the check box, turn on the restart action function
4.13.Welding Gradient\Jumping (AOUT V I)
Gradient function can be applied to welding occasions requiring gradient welding current 
and voltage.
During the execution of welding action, the current and voltage parameters of the 
welding machine can be controlled to increase or decrease gradually, and the gradual change 
process is linear.

Examples of AOUT usage:
This additional item is used to output the specified analog value in the course or end 
position of the robot.
1) V I analog output:
V I analog output can only be used in the middle of welding instructions. When the 
command is not between the welding instructions, the system executes the command line, 
the system alarms, and prompts: no welding state, can not use AOUT to change the welding 
current and voltage in motion.
V corresponds to welding voltage and I corresponds to welding current. When this 
instruction is executed from the starting point to the end point, the analog voltage changes 
linearly from the welding voltage to the specified voltage. 
Examples of procedures:
The welding current 200A corresponds to 4.95V, the welding voltage 20V to 4.95V, the 
welding current 400A to 9.95V, and the welding current 40V to 9.95V.
ARCSTART#（0） 
MOVL VL=500MM/S PL=0 AOUT V=40.0 I=400.0A
ARCEND#（0）
Program Description: When the program is executed to the first line, A1A2 first outputs 
arcing voltage; at the end of the first line instruction, A1A2 analog output 4.95V (welding 
current and voltage). From line 2 to the end of the execution, the A1 A2 analog varies 
linearly from 4.95V to 9.95V. When the third line is executed, the voltage becomes the arcextinguishing voltage.
It can be used in situations where welding current and voltage need to be changed.
2）A1 A2 analog output:
When this instruction is used between welding instructions, it will not take effect. The 
output of the system is set according to the welding process.
When not between welding instructions, the system executes until the end of this 
instruction line and then outputs A1 A2 corresponding analog. Abbreviated as Point-to-Point 
Output.
3）A3 A4 analog output:
Whether between welding instructions or not, when the system executes this command 
line, the robot changes linearly from the starting point to the end point, and the A3 A4 
analogue changes linearly from the starting point to the specified value of the end point 
command. Linear output for short.
Examples of procedures:
MOVJ VJ=30% PL=0 ；A point A3=0 A4=0

MOVL VL=500MM/S PL=0 AOUT A3=10.0 A4=10.0 ；B point
Program description: The robot moves from point A to point B, and the analog value 
of A3 A4 changes linearly from 0 V to 10 V.
The jump function can be applied to complex weld welding, where different welding 
parameters are needed for each segment.
During the execution of welding action, the current and voltage parameters of welding 
machine can be controlled to jump up or down, and the jump process can be completed 
instantaneously.

5.1 Rotation synergy:
The external axis is a rotating shaft, and one or two additional rotating shafts can be 
externally mounted. The rotating shaft can be rotated and rotated, and the 7-axis and 8-axis 
is combined with the body 6 axis to perform interpolation motion. That is, during the 
movement of the external rotating shaft, the end of the robot can still maintain linear or 
circular interpolation motion. Applicable to applications where the robot's attitude coverage 
is insufficient, but continuous operation is required, such as: intersecting wire welding, fullface round welding, etc.

Chapter 6.Fish scale welding function
6.1 Explanation of Fish Scale Welding：
Fish scales need to set the arcing detection confirmation time to 0. No arcing signal is 
confirmed.
Arc detection confirmation time, set to 0, can speed up the welding rate.
The detection time of arc extinguishing exhaustion is set to more than 0.5 seconds. If the 
arc extinguishing is unsuccessful, the alarm will be given. If you always call the police, set 
the time to a large extent.
Welding interruption arc detection is not selected. Does not detect the broken arc.
6.2 Fish scale welding instruction format:
STITCHSTART
T Spot welding time MS
L2 Empty distance MM
L1 Welding distance MM
STITCH END Instructions for the end of fish scale welding
6.3 Fish scale welding instructions:
STITCHSTART：Fish Scale Directive
T：Spot welding time，unit(MS)，range：
L1：Welding distance，unit(MM)，range：
L：Empty distance，unit(MM)，range：
STITCHEND Instructions for the end of fish scale welding。
The fish scale welding command does not itself move the robot and can only be used in 
combination with the motion command MOVL MOVC in the welding command (ARCSTART). 
The fish scale function is invalid when combined with MOVJ. This instruction cannot be used 
in other processes.
6.4 Fish scale welding work instructions:
Example 1:
1 ARCSTART 0 ：Arcing
2 STITCHSTART T 300MS L2 3MM ：Fish scale welding start, spot welding 300 ms, 3 
mm interval
3 MOVL VL=10MS/S PL=0 ：Welding Locus and Fish Scale Welding Function 
Intervention.
 4 STITCHEND ：End of Fish Scale Welding Function
5 ARCEND 0 ：Arc extinguishing
Work process:
After the first line is run, the system starts the arc according to the arcing process 
parameters, outputs the M190 signal, and then judges that M180 is valid according to the 
arcing confirmation time. Execute the second line of the program after it is valid.
After the second line is executed. The system loads the relevant parameters in the fish 
scale instruction, such as T L2, etc.
The program runs to line 3. After system delay T time, M180 is invalid according to 

arc extinguishing detection time. When M180 is invalid, the robot moves L2 length. Then 
according to the arcing requirements, the arcing time is delayed by T, and then the invalid 
M180 and the L2 length of the robot motion are judged. So (arc starting, delay T, arc 
extinguishing, empty walk L2) cycle until the third line of instruction is executed to the end.
Line 4, turn off fish scale function Then normal exercise.
Line 5 instruction, arc extinguishing.
The following figure shows the actual welding effect when the spot welding time is set to 
200 ms and the interval is 3 mm.
Example 2:
1 ARCSTART 0 ：Arcing
2 STITCHSTART L1 10MM L2 20MM ：Fish scale welding start,
3 MOVL VL=100MM/s PL=0 ：Welding Locus and Fish Scale Welding Function 
Intervention.
4 STITCHEND ：End of Fish Scale Welding Function
5 ARCEND 0 ：Arc extinguishing
Working process:
After the first line of operation, the system starts arcing according to the arcing process 
parameters, outputs M190 signal, and then judges M180 validity according to the arcing 
confirmation time. Execute the second line of procedure after it is valid.
After the second line is executed. The system loads the relevant parameters in the fish 
scale instruction, such as L1 L2, etc.
The program runs to line 3. The system controls the welding L1 length of the robot and 
judges M180 invalid according to the arc extinguishing detection time. When M180 is invalid, 
the robot moves L2 length. Then according to the arcing requirements, the arcing motion L1 
length after the arcing, and then judge that the M180 arc extinguishing is invalid, the robot 
motion L2 length. So (arcing, welding L1, arc extinguishing, empty walk L2) cycle until the 
third line of instruction is executed to the end.
Line 4, turn off fish scale function. Then normal exercise.
Line 5 instruction, arc extinguishing.

Chapter 7.Welding Search
7.1 Introduction of welding search
In the search mode, the workpiece is grounded and low voltage electricity is supplied 
through the nozzle or welding wire. When the robot moves along the trajectory, when the 
nozzle or welding wire contacts the workpiece, the level is pulled down, and the contact 
signal is generated. The robot stops moving and records the position data when it contacts 
the workpiece. The path is corrected by the deviation between the current position and the 
position set by the program, so that the real target position can be obtained.
7.1.1 Matters needing attention of welding search
Workpiece surface shall be free of rust, oxide, paint or other insulating coating
Wire shearing must be carried out before search to ensure that the elongation of the 
welding rod is the same.
When using water-cooled welding torch, distilled water or other non-conductive cooling 
liquid is recommended. Impure water (such as salt mineral water) can reduce the sensitivity 
or voltage of position finding.
The order of searching points should not be confused (e.g. 3D+, first three points in any 
direction of change in x.y.z form a surface, then two points in another direction form a line, 
and then one point in the last direction).
7.1.2 Welding search methods include:
Simple, V-port, fillet weld, inside and outside diameter, camera, point and surface.
7.1.3 The searching type contains:
3D + rotation, 2D + rotation, 2D, 1D + 1 rotation, 1D + 2 rotation, 1D. See 5 Functional 
Explanation for details.
7.1.4 Requirements for Robots before searching:
A. Robot accuracy. The accuracy of the robot is as high as possible. The higher the 
positioning accuracy of the robot, the better the positioning accuracy.
B. Check the tool coordinate system. The higher the accuracy of TCP, the better the 
accuracy. It is suggested to use our company’s 20-point calibration method. The smaller 
the calibration error, the better. If the error is greater than 2.00, the accuracy can not be 
guaranteed. Tool coordinates need to be taken in the positioning process.
C. Searching speed. The faster the speed is, the more easily the welding wire will be 
deformed and the greater the error will be. The slower the speed, the smaller the error and 
the lower the efficiency. The IO signal of this system needs 20MS time to confirm the signal. 
Example: 5MM/S speed, 20MS time corresponding error 0.1MM.
D. Searching action. The instruction line can only use MOVL. It needs to specify a bitfinding preparation point and then define a bit-finding start point. The straight line from the 
preparation point to the starting point is the welding locating direction

location of the search point to write data to the switch. When turned on, the location is stored 
in the VP variable as the reference data. After closing, the benchmark data is protected and 
no longer written. (If the flag is not off, but the workpiece moves relative to the reference 
position, the data will be written into the VP variable again after this positioning, causing the

brought into the previous point, which can reduce the deviation too large, so as to avoid the 
situation of missing location, and improve the efficiency of location. Set to OFF, will strictly 
go to the searching point , and then start to search. Incremental positioning is used for

Search distance: The distance from the searching point to the direction of the tool, 
beyond which the system will alarm.

smaller the searching speed, the higher the precision. (The system IO signal takes 20MS time 
to confirm the signal. Example: 5MM/S speed, 20MS time corresponding error 0.1MM.)
Auto return: ON/OFF. Set to ON, the robot will return along the previous motion path 
with reference to the distance and speed of automatic return after locating contact with the 
workpiece. Set to OFF, do not return.
Return distance: Set the auto-return distance. When the distance exceeds the starting 
point of the search, the robot's motion ends at the starting point of the search and is not 
running.

Return Speed: Set the Return Speed when the welding wire or nozzle touches the 
workpiece.

Camera calibration should be accurate. When assigning reference data, the data should 
correspond to the reference trajectory. The photographic point must be the same point on 
the workpiece. The attitude offset of X, Y, Z must be calculated. After the trajectory offset, the 
attitude of each point is consistent with the attitude change of the workpiece. It is used in the 
case of arbitrary rotation or translation of the object.

Explain:
The blank box behind the camera is the reference OP option.
Benchmark: The original position is also the value when editing the initial trajectory.
Reference: The changed position.
The difference between the change value and the reference value is calculated and saved

For the rotation of coordinate system, the position and attitude deviation is calculated 
and compensated by changing coordinate system and reference coordinate system. The three 
points in the coordinate system must be the corresponding points on the workpiece in turn. 
They should be used where the object rotates or moves arbitrarily.

Instruction description:
Benchmark: Three points in the benchmark coordinate system, ORG, X, Y
The latter three points are three points in the variable coordinate system, ORG, X and Y.
Reference and change coordinate systems ORG, X, Y must correspond one by one. And

Overall offset plus local offset
Look for the overall offset first, then bring the overall offset into the local offset to find 
the local offset.
Example: To achieve the idea, first find the overall offset, and then locate the local 1D 

offset based on the overall offset. When the program is executed, the overall offset is first

Chapter 8.Explanation of Arc Tracking and Debugging
8.1 Arc Tracking Hardware Connection
8.1.1 Connection Method of Arc Tracker and Ground Wire of 
Welding Machine
As shown in the figure below, the ground wire of the welder moves from the welder end 
through the arc tracker to the system end, and finally connects to the welding tooling or 
workpiece
8.1.2 Arc tracker power supply
The arc tracker is powered by conventional 220V power supply.
8.1.3 Arc Tracker Data Line Connection
As shown in the figure below, the end of the S80 pulse system is 232 interface (COM2 or 
COM4). Through 232 to 485 adapter, the signal is converted to 485 signal, and then the data 
signal line of the arc tracker is connected through DB head.
Connection Diagram of S80 Cabinet 232-485

As shown in the figure below, the S100 bus system has 485 interfaces (COM1), which can 
be directly connected to the data signal line of the arc tracker.
Connection Diagram of S100 Cabinet 485
8.2.Arc tracking parameter setting
8.2.1 Communication settings
In the system interface: [Technical] → <Arc welding > → <Arc tracking> → 
<communication set>
· Select the corresponding COM port
Selection of COM1 for S100 Bus System
Selection of COM2 or COM4 for S80 Pulse System
Selection of COM1 for CRX8 integrated electrical cabinet
· Communication parameters
Fixed baud rate set to 115200Data bits fixed to 8
Check bits are fixed to NONE
Stop Bit Fixed Set to 1
Read and write timeouts are fixed to 1000
· Background record
Need to be set to “ Record Open”

8.2.2 Upper and down compensation parameters
Set the compensation parameters in [Technical] → <Arc Welding> → <Arc 
Tracking →→ <Para Settings>:
Number
File Number Called by ARCTRACKSTRAT Instruction in Program
Annotat
Customer customization, for label, annotation
Up and down compensation function
When ON is selected, the upper and lower compensation function is turned on, and the 
upper and lower compensation parameters can be set.
When OFF is selected, the upper and lower compensation functions are closed, and the 
upper and lower compensation parameters are not set.
Up and down reference current setting
The default setting is "Feedback"
Compensation coordinate system
The default setting is "Tool coordinates"
Sampling time
The default setting is "0.5"
Up and down compensation sensitivity
When arc tracking is used to compensate the weld seam, the fluctuation is compensated 
along Z direction of the pendulum arc coordinate system. If overshoot occurs, the sensitivity 
is lowered, and if lag occurs, the sensitivity is increased.
Initial Recommended Value of Upper and Lower Compensation Sensitivity "2.5"

· Up and down compensation offset
This parameter is a standby parameter. Set it to "0" when using it.
Up and down the minimum compensation
The minimum offset of arc tracking compensation is set when the welding seam is 
compensated. The offset collected by arc tracker is less than the offset set by this parameter 
and will not be compensated.
Initial Recommended Value of Upper and Lower Minimum Compensation "0"
Up and down the cumulative maximum compensation
When arc tracking is used to compensate the welding seam, the maximum amount of 
compensation accumulated after each compensation is set. When the total compensation 
exceeds the set value of this parameter, it will not be compensated by incremental 
calculation.
Initial Recommended Value "60" of Upper and Lower Cumulative Maximum 
Compensation
Up and down the maximum compensation at every turn
Set the maximum offset of each compensation when arc tracking is used to compensate 
the weld seam. When the single deviation value collected by the arc tracker is larger than the 
set value of this parameter, no compensation will be made
Initial Recommended Value "4" for Maximum Compensation of Upper and Lower 
Quantities
Up and down compensation start counting
This parameter is an internal parameter and need not be changed when used.
· The upper and lower reference sampling start counting
This parameter is an internal parameter and need not be changed when used.
Up and down reference sampling count
This parameter is an internal parameter and need not be changed when used.
· Up and down reference current constant data
This parameter is an internal parameter and need not be changed when used.
8.2.3 Left and Right Compensation Parameters
In: [Technical] → <Arc Welding > → <Arc Tracking> → → <Para Settings>, click <Next 
page> after the upper and lower compensation settings are completed.

· Left and Right Compensation Function
When ON is selected, the left and right compensation function is turned on, and the left 
and right compensation parameters can be set.
When OFF is selected, the left and right compensation function is closed and the left and 
right compensation parameters are not set.
· Left and Right Compensation Sensitivity
When arc tracking is used to compensate the weld seam, the fluctuation is compensated 
along the Y direction of the pendulum arc coordinate system. If overshoot occurs, the 
sensitivity is lowered, and if lag occurs, the sensitivity is increased.
Initial Recommended Value of Upper and Lower Compensation Sensitivity "3.5"
· Left and Right Compensation Offset
This parameter is a standby parameter. Set it to “0” when using it.
· Left and Right Minimum Compensation
The minimum offset of arc tracking compensation is set when the welding seam is 
compensated. The offset collected by arc tracker is less than the offset set by this parameter 
and will not be compensated.
The initial recommended value of left and right minimum compensation is “0”
· Maximum cumulative compensation of left and right
When arc tracking is used to compensate the welding seam, the maximum amount of 
compensation accumulated after each compensation is set. When the total compensation 
exceeds the set value of this parameter, it will not be compensated by incremental 
calculation.
The initial recommended value of left and right cumulative maximum compensation is 
“60”
· Maximum compensation at left and right
Set the maximum offset of each compensation when arc tracking is used to compensate 
the weld seam. When the single deviation value collected by the arc tracker is larger than the 

set value of this parameter, no compensation will be made.
The initial recommended value “4” for each maximum compensation
· Left and Right Compensation Start Counting
When setting arc tracking to compensate the weld seam, the arc swing period should be 
compensated.
Left and Right Compensation Start Counting Initial Recommended Value “2”
8.3 Writing Arc Tracking Program
8.3.1 Instruction specification
·ARCTRACKSTART#(0) 0 - Arc Tracking Start
·ARCTRACKEND - End of arc tracking
8.3.2 Programming example
8.4 Notices for Arc Tracking
8.4.1 Applicable Conditions for Arc Tracking
Protective gases: CO2 and MAG
Wire diameter: 1.0~1.2
Welding rod elongation: 15mm~20mm
Welding Length and Thickness: More than 6mm
Slot angle: less than 90 degrees
8.4.2 Arc tracking welding conditions：
Welding current: over 200A
Welding speed: below 8mm/s
Minimum welding length: 70mm
Swing welding range: 3-5 mm
Pendulum Welding Frequency: 2~4HZ
Pendulum Welding Type: Z Pendulum

8.5 About the direction of the arc tracker compensation
The figure shows the pendulum arc coordinate system of CRP system.
Firstly, the calibration tool coordinate system is required. When programming, the 
corresponding tool coordinate system is also substituted for programming, as shown below.
It needs to be clear that the pendulum-arc coordinate system is based on the tool 
coordinate system, so the offset of compensation is also compensated to the pendulumarc coordinate system, which is related to the tool coordinate system. Please check the tool 
coordinate system before using it.
